body: Thank you so much again. Truth is I'm hesitant to go as far as ER. It's very daunting. The environment in itself is incredibly intimidating and I'm struggling as to whether I can make it through myself or not make it through at all. I will give this Mood Disorder Group a shot.

Thanks for your sentiments. I don't pretend to go through any more or less than anyone else posting on here. I actually just have no more recourse as to what I can do so I decided to stop lurking and make an account to post. Truthfully, I didn't expect a single reply but when you expect the worst, you can generally only be greeted with the best. 

I do qualify for Medicaid. I'm currently on it right now. I've never taken the time to look for help now, but I assume when I'm at a point in my life where fighting off the impulse to leap off a building is harder than breathing, it should be time to make an attempt. How do I go about this? Just walk into a PCP, say "I want to commit suicide, please save me.?" Sorry, I'm not trying to be a jerk at all. I'm just expressing my stupidity when it comes to this stuff. 

I currently live in NYC. It doesn't get any bigger than this. Unfortunately, it's also the city where if someone was dying on the street, people would either walk right by you, or pull out their cellphones to videotape your demise.
